== Documentation ==
The <code>DefaultCounterQuestRefColIncOnDeath.psc</code> source file documentation comments for this script.

<source>
Once this ALIAS dies it increments the counter on its Quest's DefaultCounterQuest script.
</source>

{{Script_Object_Member_Summary
| title = CheckForOnDyingInstead
| script = [[SFM:Script-DefaultCounterQuestRefColIncOnDeath|DefaultCounterQuestRefColIncOnDeath]]
| name = [[SFM:Script-DefaultCounterQuestRefColIncOnDeath/CheckForOnDyingInstead|CheckForOnDyingInstead]]
| kind = Property
| flags = Auto Const
| returns = bool
| parameters = false
| documentation = DefaultL FALSE. If true the Increment will happen when this actor recieves the OnDying() event instead, which happens the instant the actor dies, unlike the
	OnDeath() event which can happen several seconds later.
}}

{{Script_Object_Member_Summary
| title = RemoveWhenDead
| script = [[SFM:Script-DefaultCounterQuestRefColIncOnDeath|DefaultCounterQuestRefColIncOnDeath]]
| name = [[SFM:Script-DefaultCounterQuestRefColIncOnDeath/RemoveWhenDead|RemoveWhenDead]]
| kind = Property
| flags = Auto Const
| returns = bool
| parameters = false
| documentation = Default: FALSE. After incrementing, remove the alias from the collection. If MaintainTargetValue=TRUE, also decrement the counter by 1. It essentially stays at 0 while the list shrinks.
}}
